messages.content: Groq API ke saath baat cheet mein khata: khata code 429 - aik limit pani tou mil rahi hai, hum ne boht saara data use kar liya hai, ab humein 32 minute aur 47 second wait karna hai, phir hum try kar sakte hain, ya phir hum apna package upgrade kar sakte hain taa k humein zada tokens mil saken.
